decisions.rationale: Smallest option that fits the 70-minute increment: provide function shells (signatures plus a one-line purpose) and the normalization operation for isValidTitle and normalizeTitle in the increment-1 scaffold, so the learner applies only what T5 and earlier FT12 instruction taught. Function declaration syntax stays with its frozen FT13 topic.

Make feedback cumulative: Fast increment N runs its current tests while working, then all completed increment suites before completion. Standard S27 has a command that checks increment 4 together with the prerequisite scaffold it uses. Applied together with sme-recheck-02.

Define route-aware test state inside the one canonical artifact so the declared `npm test` passes on each supported route: after the Standard increment-4 route, and after each Fast increment, checking every outcome completed so far without running future increments (for example a route/progress config read by the test runner). Verify each route's command.

Specify a submit listener on the form plus one delegated click listener on the record list (or a real common ancestor, with the event path taught). Align the scaffold DOM, the worked snippet and the public DOM tests.
Remove sortRecords from increment 2, since the cumulative project's outcomes do not need sorting. Keep the explicit non-mutation requirement for the remaining functions.
